front.title: F1 Las Vegas GP: Verstappen wins thriller as Russell hits the wall late on
front.tldr: Max Verstappen won a chaotic Las Vegas Grand Prix with more than 30 lead changes, holding off both Mercedes drivers as George Russell crashed late and Ferrari's Hamilton and Leclerc collided again.

front.title: 'You Can See Everything' Crosses $100M Globally, Becomes First Doc to Hit 1M Letterboxd Watches
front.tldr: Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim's A24 documentary about Elizabeth Holmes passed $100 million worldwide in its sixth week, becoming the first documentary to reach 1 million Letterboxd logs.

front.title: How Notable Capital, GIC, and Baillie Gifford bet big on Anthropic before its IPO
front.tldr: Three early backers explain what gave them the conviction to invest billions in Anthropic ahead of its stock market listing, a rare look at how big AI bets get made.

stories.title: OpenAI's chief scientist has thoughts on how to limit AI development
stories.tldr: OpenAI's chief scientist argues that any speed limit on AI progress first needs an agreed way to measure that speed, a harder problem than it sounds.

stories.title: Select Styling Specimens
stories.tldr: Frustrated by how inconsistent and ugly HTML select boxes look across browsers, Simon Willison had Claude Fable 5.2 build a tool for designing custom ones, a small fix for an old annoyance.

stories.title: Why data centers are at the center of the Big Tech backlash
stories.tldr: Journalist Paris Marx's new book, "Hyperscale," unpacks why data centres have become the flashpoint in the public reaction against Big Tech's AI buildout.

stories.title: Perplexity and Intelligence
stories.tldr: OpenAI explains how it uses perplexity to measure progress in its models, aiming to give developers a shared way to judge emerging AI capabilities.

stories.title: Box Office: 'Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping' Debuts to Mighty $120 Million, Reviving Lionsgate's Most Important Franchise
stories.tldr: Lionsgate's prequel opened to $120 million domestically, reviving its biggest franchise, while Paul Thomas Anderson's "Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall" took just $162,000 from three cinemas.

stories.title: If There's Generative AI in 'The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth,' It's Not the First Time David Fincher's Used It
stories.tldr: David Fincher has used generative AI tools before, including in the 4K remaster of "Se7en" to bring the film closer to its original print, ahead of his new project.

stories.title: Robert Eggers Says He's "Eager" to Take a Break From Horror Genre After 'Werwulf'
stories.tldr: After a decade of horror films including "The Witch," "The Lighthouse" and "Nosferatu," director Robert Eggers says he is ready to step away from the genre following "Werwulf."

stories.title: Rian Johnson Leaves the Door Open to Star Wars Return: 'It's a World I Deeply Love'
stories.tldr: The "Last Jedi" director says he loves the Star Wars universe more than ever, as new films set after "The Rise of Skywalker" move forward under Lucasfilm's Dave Filoni.

stories.title: John Turturro Says 'I Still Consider Myself a Beginner' as He Gets Marrakech Film Festival Tribute Award
stories.tldr: Four decades into his career, John Turturro received a tribute award at the Marrakech Film Festival and says he still feels like he is just getting started.

stories.title: Down Tatum, White, and Robinson, Celtics lose to lowly Kings 97-96
stories.tldr: Missing Jayson Tatum, Derrick White and Mitchell Robinson, the Celtics lost 97-96 to the two-win Sacramento Kings, their third straight defeat.

stories.title: Ian Rapoport gives updated recovery timeline for Drake Maye
stories.tldr: There is an outside chance Drake Maye returns this season if the Patriots make the playoffs with Tommy DeVito at quarterback, per Ian Rapoport's latest update on his fibula injury.

stories.title: AFC playoff picture: Updating the Patriots postseason outlook on the bye
stories.tldr: On their bye week, the Patriots sit outside the AFC playoff picture as Mike Vrabel's team, fresh off a trip to Germany, assesses where it stands.

stories.title: F1 plans two-team engine supply limit under 2030 V8 rules
stories.tldr: Formula 1 is planning to cap engine manufacturers at two customer teams each from 2030, a change that raises questions over Mercedes' three current customer squads.

stories.title: Camara to finish F1 season with Haas, ending F2 title bid
stories.tldr: Haas rookie Rafael Camara will race out the season in Qatar and Abu Dhabi rather than chase the Formula 2 title, ahead of a full-time F1 seat in 2027.

stories.title: Battle for second place tightens as finish line nears
stories.tldr: Max Verstappen has now won four of the last six races, but with two rounds left several drivers are still bunched together fighting for second in the championship.

stories.title: Red Sox Roster Problem or Solution: Triston Casas
stories.tldr: With the Red Sox again facing a third-place finish, the site asks whether Triston Casas is part of the answer to Boston's roster problems or part of the issue.

finally.title: Jony Ive and Margaret Calvert create posters to celebrate decade of Design Museum in Kensington
finally.tldr: Ten leading designers, including Jony Ive and Margaret Calvert, created posters marking ten years of London's Design Museum in its Kensington home.
